messages:
ivy: kicking off onboard smoke for v7-quant-head (int4-adaptive) on 0.6% split. primary checks: answer_fidelity (exact-match), structured-field concordance, rerank_p10, and latency_p95. auto-fallback rules: any exact-match drop >1.5% absolute OR concordance <94% triggers immediate rollback. tagging as 'onboard-quant-head-smoke'.

noah: small ask 5  can we also measure token-level edit-distance for structured fields? that helped flag a calibration bug last time.

ivy: yep adding token_edit_rate as a second-order signal. samples: default 250, structured_heavy slice=400. qa-bot will post summaries.

ravi: recommend pinning strategic customer 'orbis' to fp16 for the run. they hit structured_forms heavily and we want to avoid noise.

ivy: pinned orbis to fp16 for the duration. enabling sample diffs on triggers. gate config (in-thread):
```
gate_id: onboard-quant-head-4267
canary_fraction: 0.006
watch_slices: ["structured_heavy","rerank_midtail","short_q"]
metrics:
  - answer_fidelity_exact: threshold_abs: -1.5% window_s: 300 action: immediate_rollback
  - structured_concordance: threshold_abs: 94% window_s: 300 action: immediate_rollback_if_below
  - token_edit_rate: threshold_abs: +1.2% window_s: 300 action: alert
  - rerank_p10: threshold_rel: -2% window_s: 600 action: rollback_after_repeat
autofallback_cooldown_s: 1800
report_interval_s: 180
notify: ["#eng-ml","#oncall"]
```

qa-bot: smoke-run started t=0. cohorts: structured_heavy(n=400), rerank_midtail(n=250), short_q(n=250). will report every 3m.

noah: small nit: set rerank_p10 rollback to 1.2% for midtail slice only; midtail churn is more visible. leave other slices at 2%.

ivy: done 5 updated policy: rerank_midtail threshold_rel: -1.2% window_s:600 action: immediate_rollback.

qa-bot: t+3m report: answer_fidelity_exact delta = -0.6% (ok), structured_concordance = 95.3% (ok), token_edit_rate +0.5% (ok), rerank_midtail delta = -0.9% (ok). no triggers.

ravi: good start. let's watch the structured_heavy tail; last int4 run had a misaligned softmax in the head.

qa-bot: t+9m report: structured_heavy concordance = 93.6% -> below 94% threshold. immediate rollback triggered for v7-quant-head. posting sample diffs and lowering canary fraction to 0.0.

ivy: ack. auto-fallback applied. pulling diffs now. freezing any auto-promotes for 24h for quant-head family.

noah: can you paste 3 representative diffs inline? even brief snippets help triage.

ivy: posted 3 diffs (trimmed):
- id 1001: fp16: "{name: \"A. Cortez\"}" -> int4: "{name: \"A. Cortes\"}" (token transposition)
- id 1024: fp16: structured phone field exact -> int4: inserted extra country code +1 -> mismatch
- id 1099: fp16: top-rank item preserved -> int4: rank flipped with lower click-score

ravi: looks like head calibration shift and a sub-tokenization alignment problem. action items: 1) roll back new head-calib patch in int4 build 2) run tokenizer-alignment sim on structured_heavy n=5k offline 3) increase structured_heavy sample to 1k next run and require 2 consecutive clean reports before promote.

ivy: creating PR to revert head-calib and ticket ML-5123. scheduling 30m triage. added guard to require two consecutive clean smoke reports (report_interval=180s) before any automated promote.

oncall-bot: paging SRE if rollback occurs again within 20m. alert policy updated.

ivy: summary: onboard canary rolled back due to structured_concordance dipping to 93.6% -> immediate rollback. pinned VIP, diffs captured, follow-ups and safeguards assigned. thanks team :shrug:
